title: looply · 类目管理（Collection）实体关系图 version: v1.1 · 2026-06-04 tables: - name: collection comment: 前台商品分组 note: is_system=TRUE 为系统级（All Products），不可删除/下架；价格筛选范围运行时按商品池动态生成，不入库 columns: - name: fc_id comment: 分组ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name_en comment: 英文名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: url_slug comment: URL路径段 constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: icon_url comment: 入口图URL constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: banner_url comment: Banner图URL constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: subtitle comment: 页面副标题 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: seo_title comment: Meta Title constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: seo_description comment: Meta Desc constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_id comment: 市场（单选） constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: channel_id comment: 渠道（单选） constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source_type comment: 选品类型 rule/manual constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: rule_config comment: 自动选品规则JSON constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: default_sort_key comment: 默认排序 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: visual_filter_enabled comment: 图文筛模块开关 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: visual_image_enabled comment: 图文筛图片模式 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: quick_filter_enabled comment: 快筛模块开关 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: products_per_page comment: 每页商品数 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 draft/active/closed constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 排序权重 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_system comment: 是否系统级 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_manual_product comment: 手动选品关联 note: UNIQUE(fc_id, listing_id)；商品下架后保留记录，is_hidden 可临时隐藏 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_id comment: 所属分组 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: listing_id comment: 商品listingID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 位置（Position） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: pinned comment: 是否固定位置 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_hidden comment: 是否隐藏 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 添加时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_hidden_product comment: 自动选品排除记录 note: UNIQUE(fc_id, listing_id)；自动选品下用于排除单个商品 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_id comment: 所属分组 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: listing_id comment: 被排除的listingID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 排除时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_auto_pin comment: 自动选品Pin位置 note: UNIQUE(fc_id, listing_id)；自动选品支持Pin，商品下架移出时同步清除pin记录 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_id comment: 所属分组 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: listing_id comment: 被固定的listingID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: position comment: Pin位置 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 固定时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: filter_dimension comment: 筛选维度（全局池） note: source_type=attribute 时经 filter_dimension_source 关联属性；展示样式按图文筛/快筛/通用筛三模块分别配置 columns: - name: dimension_id comment: 维度ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: dimension_name_en comment: 英文名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source_type comment: 数据源类型 attribute/brand/series/price/condition/backend_category constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source_config comment: '数据源配置JSON（类目: 勾选节点+展示名+树/打平）' constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: disp_visual comment: 图文筛展示样式 card/color constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: disp_quick comment: 快筛展示样式 card/panel/slider/color constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: disp_common comment: 通用筛展示样式 card/panel/slider/color constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: value_mapping comment: 值归一化规则JSON constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: min_fill_rate comment: 最低填充率阈值 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 active/inactive constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: filter_dimension_source comment: 维度-属性多源绑定 note: UNIQUE(dimension_id, attribute_id)；仅 source_type=attribute 的维度使用 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: dimension_id comment: 所属筛选维度 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: attribute_id comment: 关联属性定义ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: priority comment: 多源优先级 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_quick_filter comment: 快筛项配置 note: UNIQUE(fc_id, dimension_id)；快筛每项引用一个筛选维度；模块总开关在 collection.quick_filter_enabled columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_id comment: 所属分组 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: dimension_id comment: 引用的筛选维度 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 排序 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 active/inactive constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_visual_filter comment: 图文筛项配置 note: 每项=展示文案+图片+一组筛选项(condition_config)；多个筛选维度间AND、同维度多枚举值OR，不支持OR组合/嵌套；维度引用筛选器池；无系统级All项 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_id comment: 所属分组 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: display_label comment: 展示文案 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: image_url comment: 图片URL（图文模式必填） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: condition_config comment: 筛选项JSON（维度AND·同维度多值OR） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 排序 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 active/inactive constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_sort_config comment: Collection排序项配置 note: UNIQUE(fc_id, sort_key)；决定本 Collection 展示哪些排序项(recommended/newest/price/manual)、顺序及默认项 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_id comment: 所属分组 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_key comment: 排序项key constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 展示顺序 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_default comment: 是否默认排序 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 active/inactive constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: listing comment: 商品上架记录 note: 外部引用，字段由商品系统维护，不在本模块展开 columns: - name: listing_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: attribute_def comment: 属性定义 note: 外部引用，字段由商品系统维护，不在本模块展开 columns: - name: attribute_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: brand comment: 品牌 note: filter_dimension source_type=brand 时的数据来源（逻辑引用） columns: - name: brand_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: series comment: 系列 note: filter_dimension source_type=series 时的数据来源（逻辑引用） columns: - name: series_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market comment: 市场 note: collection.market_id 引用，控制商品池范围（逻辑引用） columns: - name: market_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: channel comment: 渠道 note: collection.channel_id 引用，读商品中心渠道管理（逻辑引用） columns: - name: channel_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: backend_category comment: 后台类目 note: 既作为 filter_dimension 数据源(source_type=backend_category)，也用于 rule_config 条件字段（均为逻辑引用，非FK） columns: - name: category_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: collection to: fc_manual_product type: 1:N label: 手动选品 color: '#2D72B8' penwidth: 1.8 - from: collection to: fc_hidden_product type: 1:N label: 排除记录 color: '#2D72B8' penwidth: 1.4 - from: collection to: fc_auto_pin type: 1:N label: 自动选品Pin color: '#2D72B8' penwidth: 1.4 - from: collection to: fc_quick_filter type: 1:N label: 快筛配置 color: '#2D72B8' penwidth: 1.4 - from: collection to: fc_visual_filter type: 1:N label: 图文筛配置 color: '#2D72B8' penwidth: 1.4 - from: collection to: fc_sort_config type: 1:N label: 排序配置 color: '#2D72B8' penwidth: 1.4 - from: filter_dimension to: fc_quick_filter type: 1:N label: 被快筛引用 color: '#2E7D4F' penwidth: 1.4 - from: filter_dimension to: fc_visual_filter type: '' label: 'condition_config 引用
（JSON，非FK）' color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed - from: filter_dimension to: filter_dimension_source type: 1:N label: 多源绑定 color: '#2E7D4F' penwidth: 1.4 - from: listing to: fc_manual_product type: 1:N label: FK color: '#9E9E9E' penwidth: 1.0 - from: listing to: fc_hidden_product type: 1:N label: FK color: '#9E9E9E' penwidth: 1.0 - from: listing to: fc_auto_pin type: 1:N label: FK color: '#9E9E9E' penwidth: 1.0 - from: attribute_def to: filter_dimension_source type: 1:N label: FK color: '#9E9E9E' penwidth: 1.0 - from: brand to: filter_dimension type: '' label: source_type=brand color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed - from: series to: filter_dimension type: '' label: source_type=series color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed - from: backend_category to: filter_dimension type: '' label: source_type=backend_category color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed - from: backend_category to: collection type: '' label: 'rule_config 条件字段
（JSON引用，非FK）' color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed - from: market to: collection type: '' label: market_id color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed - from: channel to: collection type: '' label: channel_id color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed design_rules: R-01: Collection 无层级嵌套，扁平结构，导航层级由 Navigation 模块承载 R-02: 商品粒度为 listing 级别，不按 SPU 聚合 R-03: 自动选品/手动选品两种模式互斥（source_type=rule 或 manual） R-04: All Products 为系统级 Collection（is_system=TRUE），不可删除、不可下架、rule_config 为空（全量） R-05: 自动选品支持 Pin（fc_auto_pin）；商品因下架移出 Collection 时同步清除对应 pin 记录 R-06: 手动选品商品下架后 fc_manual_product 记录保留，is_hidden=TRUE，商品重新上架后恢复 R-07: backend_category 既可作为 filter_dimension 的 source_type，也用于 rule_config 条件字段 R-08: filter_dimension source_type=attribute 时，通过 filter_dimension_source 支持多个 attribute_def 绑定到同一维度（尺码亦走 attribute） R-09: 后台商品列表顺序 = 前端实际展示顺序（WYSIWYG），sort_order 字段即最终渲染位置；sort_key=manual（手动排序）即按 fc_manual_product.sort_order / fc_auto_pin.position 的 Pin/拖拽位置展示 R-10: 快筛 chip 商品数为 0、或图文筛绑定的 value 在当前商品池不存在时，前端实时隐藏该项 R-11: filter_dimension 填充率低于 min_fill_rate 时前台自动隐藏该维度分组（每日 cron 更新） R-12: 展示样式按图文筛/快筛/通用筛三模块分别配置（disp_visual/disp_quick/disp_common），可选样式=数据源允许∩模块支持 R-13: backend_category 作数据源时，展示样式决定前端返回结构：文字卡片=打平末级类目(忽略父类目)，折叠面板=父子树结构 R-14: 价格筛选范围运行时按各 Collection 商品池动态生成（min=$0，max=最高价向上取整到百位），不入库 R-15: 通用筛选器零配置：按当前商品池从全局维度池(status=active)动态匹配，无 Collection 级配置表
